otter-ai-alternatives.27: Otter is worth it if you need fast English transcription and live captions. It is less worth it if you need notes turned into tasks, in-person capture in the same tool, or meetings longer than 30 minutes on a free plan. Weigh those three gaps first.
otter-ai-alternatives.32: The right pick among Otter AI alternatives depends on the job. Fireflies, if your CRM sits at the center of your sales process. Fathom for free unlimited recording, Granola for private bot-free notes, Read AI for meeting analytics. Pick Lynkk if you want one AI that preps you before the call, answers during it and does the follow-up work after.
otter-ai-alternatives.31: Most tools accept audio uploads rather than Otter's own files, so export your transcripts as TXT or DOCX from Otter and keep them in your docs, then let the new tool capture meetings going forward. Run both for a week. Compare.
otter-ai-alternatives.1: This guide compares eight tools on what actually changes your week. Free limits. Real prices, who each tool suits, and what happens after the meeting ends.
